documents.title: Framework agreement
documents.text:
Framework agreement: Kalvik Foods (fictional, authored test material).
Annual service charges at Kalvik Foods stood at SEK 2.2m in FY2025 (reported basis). Kalvik Foods had incident response time of 2 hours in the twelve months to 31 Mar 2025. For Kalvik Foods, performance bond in FY2025 was SEK 28.4 million (reported basis). Total contract value at Kalvik Foods stood at NZD 95.1m in FY2025 (reported basis).

documents.title: Change order
documents.text:
Change order: Kalvik Foods (fictional, authored test material).
Kalvik Foods trades under the name Copperline. Payment terms at Copperline stood at 75 days in FY2024. Kalvik Foods had yearly fees of SEK 2.4m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Kalvik Foods, incident response time in FY2025 was 3 hours. Volume rebate at Kalvik Limited stood at 2.9% in FY2024. The ownership of deliverables for Kalvik Foods is understood as follows: the supplier keeps ownership and grants a perpetual licence. Throughout the documents of this review, "yearly fees" means the same measure as annual service charges.

documents.title: Procurement evaluation note
documents.text:
Procurement evaluation note: Kalvik Foods (fictional, authored test material).
Kalvik Foods has a financial year ending on 31 March; FY2025 is the year ended 31 March 2025. Payment terms at Kalvik Foods stood at 84 days in FY2024. Kalvik Foods had performance bond of SEK 25.2m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Kalvik Foods, total contract value in FY2025 was NZD 121.1 million (reported basis). Volume rebate at Kalvik Ltd stood at 3.3% in FY2024. The ownership of deliverables for Kalvik Foods is understood as follows: all deliverables vest in the customer on payment.
